correctness.rationale: For the specified diagonal order-three action on A=E^4 over C, the product polarization identifies NS(A) with rank-16 Herm_4(Z[zeta]). Fixed-point characters for rank-one generators have quadratic part t^T Hbar t on A[1-zeta]=F3^4. Equivariant degree-zero twists add only affine-linear characters, which cannot cancel a nonzero quadratic residue in odd characteristic. Therefore the Cartier pullback image is precisely the kernel of Herm_4(R)->Sym_4(F3), index 3^10; finite-surjective pullback identifies nef/pseudo-effective cones with PSD matrices, and D_H^4=8 det(H). Primitive rank-one rays vv* are extremal, rational and infinitely numerous and have exact Cartier multiplier three. Independently checked quadratic evaluation rank 10, affine rank 5 and disjointness on all 81 fixed points. The rank calculation checks the explicit finite linear algebra; descent and cone statements follow the supplied proof and cited finite-descent theorem, not numerical experiments.
